messages:
maria: Patch applied to libcurl (CVE-2026-2345) to staging images. Can we run post-patch validation + canary tomorrow 18:00 UTC? Need: smoke tests, perf regression checks, KMS/RBAC verification, and audit log validation. Tagging @sanjay @kevin @tess

sanjay: Ack. I'll spin up a 10% canary pool in staging and run the smoke checklist. Key checks: /health, TLS handshake, upload/download flows, and S3 proxy paths. Will post commands and short runbook here.

sanjay: ```
# quick smoke commands
curl -v https://staging-canary.redwood.internal/health
./smoke.sh --target staging-canary --tests upload,download,tls
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/nginx-proxy-canary
```

kevin: KMS note: this libcurl patch touches client cert handling. Before we push more traffic, confirm KMS key bindings allow the canary service account (redwood-canary@proj) to Sign/Encrypt. Run:
`gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/curl-sign-key`

kevin: Also validate there are no RBAC shortcuts granting `roles/owner` to the canary SA. We want least privilege for the canary.

tess: Observability gating: create a temporary alert for the canary rollout. Watch p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, and token fetch time. Suggested thresholds: p95 +15% over baseline, p99 +25%, error rate +0.5%. Dashboards: /dash/serving/latency and /dash/kms/ops.

alex: If tail latency or errors spike, we should flip routing to fallback to previous libcurl build. Use routing feature flag `libcurl_fallback=previous` and scale canary back to 0%. I'll own the rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment queued for libcurl-patch-2026-2345 -> staging-canary (10% traffic). Link: https://deploys.redwood/inference/1912345678

jie: For audit logs: confirm KMS Sign/Encrypt events and process exec events during the canary window. Example query:
`gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name=staging AND protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt"' --limit 50`
Also check auditd for `execve` of the updated binary.

sanjay: First smoke run completed. Results: all checks passed except an intermittent 502 on the upload test that hit the s3 proxy. Excerpt from proxy log:
```
proxy: upstream read error: connection reset by peer
```

kevin: 502 could be unrelated but worth confirming TLS stack on canary nodes. Run:
`curl --tlsv1.3 --cert-status https://10.2.4.18:8443/health` against canary pod IPs. If KMS signing fails we'll see 403s / TLS handshake errors.

tess: Perf snapshot (canary, last 30m): p50 +1%, p95 +3%, p99 +12% (spikes during batch writes). Token fetch latency unchanged. No new error patterns in logs yet. I'll keep eyes on the alert windows.

maria: Plan: hold at 10% for 2h. If p99 stays < +20% and no auth/audit failures, promote to 50% then to full rollout. Sanjay/Kevi n/Jie — please confirm KMS audit and RBAC checks by EOD.

sanjay: Confirming — running RBAC checklist now and will attach `canary-smoke-results.log` after the next run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual scale: staging-canary -> 50% traffic (initiated by infra).

alex: If anything looks off during the 50% window ping me immediately and I'll trigger rollback. :thumbsup:
